subject.title: Centralize chat-session naming; define subagent session lifetime & cross-channel persistence

question: What should be the canonical OpenClaw contract for ACP/subagent session names, lifetime, and cross-channel persistence?
rationale: The current code has multiple partial mechanisms, but the requested outcome changes user-visible session metadata, lifecycle cleanup, provider disclosure, and cross-channel identity boundaries.

options.title: Define Core/Gateway Contract First
options.body: Set the title precedence, generated-title opt-in boundary, ACP/native subagent lifetime rules, and identity persistence semantics before queueing implementation.

options.title: Split Into Narrower Trackers
options.body: Keep this as an umbrella and move title quality, ACP archive lifecycle, and cross-channel persistence into separately owned implementation issues.

options.title: Defer Broader Generated Titles
options.body: Leave general auto-titling to the open product discussion while only documenting current ACP/native lifecycle behavior now.

recommendation.title: Define Core/Gateway Contract First
recommendation.body: Set the title precedence, generated-title opt-in boundary, ACP/native subagent lifetime rules, and identity persistence semantics before queueing implementation.
